items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Ralph Cooper; he had six weeks in the Appollo, and I went in the Appollo for six weeks.

ctx.x: I'm just trying to think of some of the other bands you might have done some gigs with.
I worked with Ralph Cooper; he had six weeks in the Appollo, and I went in the Appollo for six weeks.
That's right; he practically opened that place.
